name: oked
description: Ask a person before Claude Code runs a risky action. Decisions happen in Telegram or on the web dashboard.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: OKed API key from /oked:pair. Leave this empty until you pair. This is the only API key the plugin reads. Risky actions return ask until a key is saved.

githubToken.title: GitHub token
githubToken.description: Optional. Used only to read a pull request title for an approval card. Leave empty to skip that lookup.
